content.text:
Yes—**mbx 1.8.1 rejected the macOS universal build**. The [failed job](https://github.com/jdx/usage/actions/runs/33987850906/job/101364811217) ran:

```sh
cargo build --release --bin usage --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml \
  --target aarch64-apple-darwin --target x86_64-apple-darwin
```

mbx immediately returned:

```text
mbx[error]: managed linker selection supports one Cargo --target per invocation
```

The guard is in [managed_linker.rs](/Users/jdx/src/mr-boxington/crates/mbx/src/managed_linker.rs:431). The upload action passes both architectures to one Cargo invocation, which mbx rejects before compilation.

All Linux and Windows builds succeeded. The macOS failure caused the final release and packslip jobs to be skipped.

Immediate workaround: set `MBX_DISABLE=1` on that build step. The underlying fix is for mbx to handle multiple Cargo targets.
